decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a renamed and upgraded version of the well-received BASIC 518 trommel and has its own page, so it is likely a core product.
The mobile flail shredder line fits the core mobile recycling portfolio and is prominently presented on its own page.
The high-speed grinder line is a recent launch that broadens the mobile shredding offering, and the firm would likely give it more than one year despite only being mentioned on the website.
This is a niche stationary electric fine shredder with low visibility, but it supports the firm's stationary plant business and growing demand for electric drives.
The green-waste grinder serves the firm's established composting and biomass customers, although it overlaps somewhat with Product C.
The stationary pre-shredder line has its own page and supports international plant-based solutions, which matches the firm's strategy.
